{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (e.g., < 0.33) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude after a sharp spike in price (e.g., > 5% from prior day) to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if 3 consecutive forecast days are above true outcome, reduce next forecast by 5-10%.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent true outcomes when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive (0.33–0.50).",
    "For long-term (30-day) forecasts, cap upward bias at +15% above recent 7-day average to prevent overconfidence.",
    "If sentiment history includes a 0.67 or higher positive signal, slightly increase forecast to reflect bullish momentum.",
    "When true outcome is significantly below forecast (e.g., > 10% under), adjust next forecast downward by 5–10% to correct for lagged overreaction."
  ]
}
